firstMilestone.title: From fuel to the front wheels

lessons.title: Four-stroke petrol engine
lessons.question: How does burning fuel inside four cylinders turn a steel shaft?
lessons.objective: Step through intake, compression, power and exhaust across two full crankshaft revolutions (720 degrees) and see why only one stroke produces work.
lessons.vehicleApplicability: 2019 Japan-market Toyota RAV4 X uses a 2.0-litre M20A-FKS inline-four four-stroke petrol engine. The interactive 3D cutaway is the stock Inkworks generic inline-four four-stroke petrol demonstration (firing order 1-3-4-2) rather than a CAD replica of the M20A-FKS.
controls: 2D four-stroke step controls (Previous, Next, direct phase buttons) always available without WebGL
Click-to-load Inkworks 3D figure with Play/Pause, Step, Slow motion, Throttle slider, Cylinder selector and Orbit
Link to full Inkworks engineering drafting sheet
lessons.fallback: Interactive SVG cutaway of a single cylinder showing piston position, intake/exhaust valves, spark and stroke description for all four strokes, usable with keyboard, touch, reduced motion and WebGL disabled.
simplifications: Generic inline-four geometry, 10:1 illustrative compression ratio and belt-driven cams from the stock Inkworks engine demo.
Pressure curve and valve lift profiles are smooth closed-form teaching approximations rather than measured M20A-FKS cylinder pressure traces.

lessons.title: Transmission, final drive and differential
lessons.question: How does engine rotation reach the front tyres, and why do the front wheels turn at different speeds in a corner?
lessons.objective: Trace torque from the engine through the Direct Shift-CVT launch gear and belt variator into the final drive, open differential and front wheels.
lessons.vehicleApplicability: 2019 Japan-market Toyota RAV4 X FWD uses Toyota's Direct Shift-CVT (mechanical launch gear plus steel-belt variator) integrated with a front transaxle final drive and differential.
controls: Interaction 1: Direct Shift-CVT Launch vs Cruise mode toggle, plus a Belt Ratio slider active in Cruise mode
Interaction 2: Open Differential Straight, Left turn and Right turn selector with Pause/Play and Reset
lessons.fallback: Native inline SVG diagrams with live synchronized text readouts and static labels; requires no WebGL and supports reduced motion and keyboard controls.
simplifications: Launch-to-belt mode switching is reader-controlled so the lesson does not imply engine RPM alone triggers the real transmission's shift schedule.
Illustrative ratio range (low to overdrive) and cornering wheel-speed split demonstrate operating principles without claiming exact OEM gear tooth counts or vehicle road speeds.
